text_fidelity_a:
LotFancy Laptop Cooler Cooling Pad with 5 Quiet Fans for 12-17" Notebook, Dual USB Ports A good laptop chiller pad becomes important when you run a lot of graphics-intensive games or if you are doing anything requiring the CPU to run a heavy load. Heat is the enemy of a computer system and the fastest way to a dead laptop is to not deal with heat issues when there’s a problem. I had a chill pad some time ago and it was sub-par. This one by LotFancy is much better and it does a good job.

First off, this is a big chill pad, the same basic dimensions as my laptop but much thicker. I have a 15.6" laptop and this pad is almost a perfect and exact fit, with only a narrow area in the back that extends past the end of the laptop. If you want a small and petite chill pad, this is not the one you want. It does incline too with a metal bar and slots in the case so that the laptop can be angled up. This actually is good for exposing it to even more air.

This chill pad connects to a USB port so it can either be plugged into a port on the computer or into a hub. There are two ports on it and both seem to be the same in terms of how the pad operates. That is, the pad operates at the same speed regardless of which port is used. There are also two buttons on the pad for turning it on. One turns on the larger fan in the middle, and the other turns on all the other fans. Two green LEDs next to those buttons indicate that the pad is powered on and working.

This pad moves a lot of air and it does a good job of cooling the laptop. But, it does so very quietly which is a huge plus. I have it set up in my home office and the pad makes about as much noise as a desktop computer, maybe a little less. The sound it makes is a gentle hum.

When powered on each fan has a bright blue LED in it. While they look cool when there’s no laptop on the pad, they’re all but invisible when the laptop is sitting on top. There isn’t even much of a glow coming from the pad. I turned on the pad, turned out all of the lights and the glow from the laptop screen was enough to overpower any light that might have come from the pad. Except for the low hum I wouldn’t know it was even turned on.

This is a good chill pad. It works quietly and it moves a lot of air. Compared to other chill pads I have used this one is very good and I am happy to recommend it.

Disclaimer: I was provided a sample of this product in exchange for a fair, honest and thorough review. Even though I received this product at no cost I have rated and reviewed this product without bias, based solely on my experience with it.

Sony Wireless Headphones WH-CH510: Wireless Bluetooth On-Ear Headset with Mic for phone-call, Blue When I talk to my friends for hours on end the last thing I want to do is hold my iPhone in my hand up to my ear or even be on speaker phone. My husband does not like hearing the speaker phone when he's trying to concentrate on his iPhone. It takes too much effort to talk on a speaker phone for hours. So as soon as I answer the phone I switch over to these headphones and talk through the microphone in the headphones. Perfect!

My friend who calls me once a week sounds like a radio DJ, in fact he used to be one but the headphones make him sound that way just naturally. It is really cute. He's always had a nice voice but this makes him come through like rich stereo sound. At first I thought I was talking to a stranger, but got used to his new voice sound.

You just have to hold the button down for a few seconds and an AI voice tells you what the headphones are doing. So if you are finished with the headset you just press the middle button and it tells you the headset is off. So that saves on battery power and makes it easy to know when the power is on or off. I find that I can make these the best volume easily and have it now where I don't need to change it at all.

My friend who calls me every week told me about these headphones and I bought them on his recommendation. I had these years before I got an iPhone because I prepare ahead of time!!!! Now that I have a new iPhone 14 I'm happy as can be with my headset. Since the microphone is built in this is perfect for phone calls but it also works like a regular headphone if you want to listen to audio on your phone. I haven't started listening to music on it yet but will report back when I do. The sound is just superior to any headphones besides my AKG K553s.

Fit & Fresh Protective Laptop Sleeve with Zippered Storage Pocket, Laptop Bag fits Apple/Microsoft/Acer/Samsung/Google/Lenovo with up to 15.6" Displays, Space Dyed, Gray I have a wonderful hybrid laptop/tablet but the problem is that I needed a case that was slim, but would protect my laptop even while it was being charged. I had a few dings in it from banging on edges of things, so when I saw this, I was hoping it would be perfect. Let's see what happened..

WHAT IS THIS SLEEVE LIKE?
I have backpacks, and big cases to put laptops in, but I just wanted a protective sleeve. That is precisely what this is. It is a fabulous protective sleeve for protecting the laptop. It is lined in very soft velveteen. There is a zipper pocket on the front which has a metal zipper, but is lined with BRIGHT LIME GREEN LINING. I am sorry. I had to capitalize that because I am so excited about it. It is slick so anything put inside will slide in and out easily. It matches the small colored patch on either end of the sleeve.

The outside of the sleeve is like dark denim in color. It is tougher than denim, however. The inside is a light gray. All edges are bound in tough nylon so there are no edges to fray. Workmanship is excellent on this. It is well made.

DOES IT FIT?
My laptop is a 15inch laptop and it fits perfectly. The most exciting part is that I can leave it unzipped and it gives me the room to leave the recharging jack in the laptop so I can recharge it while protecting it. When not recharging, I can zip it shut, put the charger in the pocket and be on my way. I can also zip from both sides leaving the top open if I want and the cord can still come out for recharging. (It has a two way zipper with two zipper heads on each end).

THE BOTTOM LINE
For a protective sleeve that is fresh looking and protective, this is a winner for me. It is soft inside, bright lined outside pocket, and strong workmanship all around. I am very happy with this and highly recommend it.

MY RATING
Five stars for this.
text_fidelity_b: Fit & Fresh Protective Laptop Sleeve with Zippered Storage Pocket, Laptop Bag fits Apple/Microsoft/Acer/Samsung/Google/Lenovo with up to 15.6" Displays, Space Dyed, Gray

text_fidelity_a:
Fikwot FS810 500GB SSD SATA III 2.5" 6GB/s, Internal Solid State Drive 3D NAND Flash (Read/Write Speed up to 550/500 MB/s) Compatible with Laptop & PC Desktop I can't believe how inexpensive SSDs are now, I was very skeptical this could be a real product at this price tag but sure enough, there it is- giving me roughly 450MB/s read and 415 MB/s write. Granted these are no where near even the most basic NVMe speeds, but it is still easily 2-3x your average mechanical spinning drive and a fraction of the power consumption. So if you're looking to boot fast or upgrade an old spinning mechanical drive, this price is a no brainer.
I don't know how long it will last, as another reviewer said the actual chips used internally aren't bad- they are well known and mass produced. But there's no guarantees as this Fikwot brand hasn't been around long enough to have a reputation for longevity. I'm happily using it to revive an old laptop and turn it into a chromebook. It is plenty fast and a bargain for the price.
text_fidelity_b: Fikwot FS810 500GB SSD SATA III 2.5" 6GB/s, Internal Solid State Drive 3D NAND Flash (Read/Write Speed up to 550/500 MB/s) Compatible with Laptop & PC Desktop

Inventiv Sport Wireless Bluetooth Audio Sunglasses, Open Ear Headphones Music & Hands-Free Calling, for Men & Women, Polarized Glasses Lenses (Black Frame/Blue Tint) I like to listen to audio books as I go on bike rides, so I've been looking for a product like this. When I run I use over the ear headphones, but I can't fit those on over or under my cycling helmet. These sunglasses are a great solution. There are speakers underneath the arms that broadcast music almost directly into your ears. The effect is an open ear speaker system that allows you to hear your music, but also lets you stay mindful of ambient noises.

The sunglasses have enough of a tint to be comfortable, but not so much that they are impractical in low light. The arms rest easily on your ears and the nose piece is a solid bit of plastic that does not pinch the bridge of your nose. The glasses are very light even with the battery and speaker system.

The sunglasses connect to your cell phone via Bluetooth without any issues. There is a large power button on the right arm that is easy to locate by touch. I preferred these for comfort and for sound quality to ear buds. The sound quality is about what you'd expect for tiny speakers mounted to the arms of sunglasses. It's not concert hall quality, but it gets the job done, and it's better than a lot of other speakers on the market.

These sunglasses are great for athletes who like to listen to music while they're out exercising. Also included is a case, a bag, a lens cloth, and a charging cable.

text_fidelity_a:
Poly - Voyager Focus 2 UC USB-C Headset (Plantronics) - Bluetooth Dual-Ear (Stereo) Headset with Boom Mic - USB-C PC/Mac Compatible - Active Noise Canceling - Works with Teams, Zoom (Certified) & More Ok, so I have to admit at first I was wondering why someone would spend this much on a Bluetooth headset that isn't a feature-rich entertainment one like those from Sony or a major fad brand like Beats, both of which I have some experience with. But this, no... this is actually something different. This is a serious tool for serious use with serious built quality and seriously useful features. Seriously.
For example, the telescoping mouthpiece means you'll get unparalleled mic quality compared to headsets that pick the mic up by your ears (looking at YOU, airpods!), both in clarity and isolation from background noise. You can also physically bend it out of the way, or use the button on the mic itself to mute. Try doing that with airpods. Then there's the button based features. Shortcuts and touch-sensitive buttons are cool on aesthetic devices, but the physical controls on this are an ergonomic user experience DREAM. Everything is easy to access and control, no apps or press-and-hold or counting LED blinks, etc. Sort of makes me miss the old days of phones with physical switches and buttons. When you want your equipment to get serious, this is the sort of user experience you expect. Then there's the charging rack. OMG I love that, I can store it on my desk and it's charging automagically. Pick it up and put it on, ready to go. Never needs to be charged because it's been charging in between uses. Finally, I'm really impressed with the USB dongle option. You see, the one thing I really dislike about wireless headphones is that you usually need to pair it with a device, then unpair it to switch to another device. For example, using my Sony headphones on my phone and tablet, if my wife wants to borrow them for a zoom meeting, I need to pair with her device but then also unpair with mine so that it doesn't keep trying to reconnect to it. Sometimes we just give up and use a wired headset to avoid that mess. Non-bluetooth wireless headsets have a dongle, which makes it easy to swap what you are connected to (no unpairing needed, just move the dongle) but then you can't connect to devices without a USB port like a phone. This is the best of both- you can pair it with your phone, but ALSO use the USB to quickly connect with your desktop or laptop without going through the process of pairing and unpairing. This is the kind of usability and professional quality I would expect from a brand like Plantronics, and all the while it works well as a stereo headset for music/gaming/etc as well. Very comfortable to wear for long hours, I'd highly recommend it for serious users.
text_fidelity_b: Poly - Voyager Focus 2 UC USB-C Headset (Plantronics) - Bluetooth Dual-Ear (Stereo) Headset with Boom Mic - USB-C PC/Mac Compatible - Active Noise Canceling - Works with Teams, Zoom (Certified) & More

Creative Pebble V2 - Minimalistic 2.0 USB-C Powered Desktop Speakers, 3.5 mm AUX-in, Up to 8W RMS Power for Computers and Laptops, Type-A Adapter Included and Extended Cable (Black) PROS:
NICE SOUND! Would these compete with REALLY high end speakers? No, but for little desktop speakers, they're GREAT! BETTER than ones that cost more.
